Processor: Intel i3-1315U 6-Core Processor (Up to 4.5 GHz with Intel Turbo Boost Technology | 10 MB Intel Smart cache| 6 Cores: 2 Performance Core + 4 Efficient Core, 8 Threads)
 Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics
 Operating system: Windows 11 Home 64-bit
 Memory: 16GB DDR4 SDRAM
 Hard Drive: 256GB PCIe SSDStorage
 Optical Drive: No
 Display: 14-inch diagonal, FHD (1920 x 1080) 250 nits, 45% NTSC color gamut, 16:9 aspect ratio, 60Hz, Thin Bezel LCD
 Connectivity: MediaTek Wi-Fi 6E (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.3
 Audio: SonicMaster Built-in Speaker
 Built-in HD Webcam: 720p HD camera with privacy shutter
 Ports:
 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C
 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A
 2 x USB 2.0 Type-A
 1 x HDMI v1.4
 1 x Coaxial plug power jack
 1 x Headphone / Microphone combo audio jack
 Battery: 3 Cell 42Wh, (up to 8 hours non-gaming battery life)
 Color: Quiet Blue
 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 12.79 x 8.42 x 0.7
 Weight: 3.09 lbs

items: 【Powerful Intel i3 13th Gen Laptop】Equipped with the latest Intel Core i3-1315U 6-Core (2P+4E, 8 threads, up to 4.5GHz) processor, this thin and light 14-inch laptop delivers fast, efficient performance for everyday computing, business, school, and entertainment.

【Upgraded DDR4 RAM + Expanded PCIe SSD】Enjoy ultra-smooth multitasking with massive upgraded high-bandwidth RAM and lightning-fast expanded PCIe solid-state drive for quick boot-ups, large file storage, and seamless app performance.

【14” Full HD Thin Bezel Display】Experience sharp detail on a compact 14-inch FHD (1920x1080) screen with 250 nits brightness, 45% NTSC color, anti-glare coating, and slim bezels – perfect for streaming, browsing, and work on the go.

【Wi-Fi 6E + Webcam with Privacy Shutter】Stay connected with next-gen Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3. The built-in 720p HD webcam with privacy shutter and microphone makes video calls secure and clear for Zoom, Teams, and remote learning.

【Portable & Stylish Design】Lightweight at just 3.09 lbs, finished in sleek Quiet Blue, this student and business laptop offers up to 8 hours battery life and versatile ports including USB-C, HDMI, and multiple USB-A to keep you productive anywhere.
